authentication: Firebase Auth + enforced App Check for every callable

searchSharedSchedulesV2.response: result: public summaries only, truncated:boolean; no UID or rules in summaries
searchSharedSchedulesV2.limits: 9 adjacent 0.1 degree cells, 501 candidate read cap, maximum 50 approximate-distance-sorted results; truncated is not a complete nearest-neighbor result

getSharedScheduleV2.response: id, name, rules, sourceUrl?:string (registered HTTP/HTTPS reference URL; omitted when absent or invalid)

saveSharedScheduleV2.ownership: writes only user-{authenticated UID}; request cannot choose owner/id/status/official flag
saveSharedScheduleV2.privacy: coordinates rounded to 0.01 degree; no full address, FCM token or numeric legacy user ID

unpublishSharedScheduleV2.ownership: withdraw only user-{authenticated UID}; absence is idempotent

acceptanceOnDevice: Upgrade retains locally saved schedules and notification preferences
Search never calls legacy PHP; errors remain on search screen with retry and manual entry
Selecting a shared rule does not overwrite saved schedules until Save
Nth weekday and alternating-week anchor survive fetch/save
Sharing defaults OFF; local Save works offline
Sharing ON shows name/rules/approximate location disclosure and writes own contribution only
Sharing failure keeps editor and offers retry or local save
Explicit withdrawal removes own contribution from search while local schedule remains
Existing public contribution is not silently deleted when local sharing toggle is OFF
Anonymous account can edit only its own contribution; after reinstall old ownership is not assumed
deployment: not deployed; Firestore index and production Auth/App Check configuration remain unverified
